question_zh: 是否提供售后跟进或保修？
question_en: Is after-sales support or warranty included?
answer_zh: 售后会按已确认的项目范围跟进。施工保障、供应商保修、适用范围、例外情况与期限，应以报价单或项目文件中的书面说明为准。
answer_en: After-sales follow-up is handled according to the confirmed project scope. Any workmanship coverage, supplier warranty, exclusions, and duration should be stated in the quotation or project documents for your review.
